No fresh authenticated end-to-end probes were run; health and passive traffic are not equivalent to verifying every route.
Ten-second samples cannot exclude shorter interruptions or attribute a sampled retry to a particular customer stream.

Queue drops are driver datagrams and KCP OutSegs is protocol segments; their ratio is contextual, not a wire-loss estimate.
